title: Binary Search Tree, Sums and Curves

scenes.heading: Three ideas, three visuals
scenes.narration: Today we see three ideas, a tree, a sum, and a curve.

scenes.heading: Insert into a search tree
scenes.narration: Insert fifteen first, and it becomes the root. Seven is smaller, so it goes left. Twenty three is bigger, so it goes right. Eleven goes left of fifteen, then right of seven.

scenes.heading: Sum of one to n
scenes.narration: Write the sum once. Add it to itself, reversed. Each pair adds to n plus one. Divide by two, and the sum is n times n plus one, over two.

scenes.heading: Slope and area
scenes.narration: Take the curve f of x equals x squared. At x equals one, the slope is two. The area under it from zero to two is eight thirds. Slope tells how fast it changes, and area tells how much it adds up.

scenes.heading: Recap
scenes.narration: Trees use sorted order. Sums reverse and pair. Curves show slope and area. Subscribe for Day 17.
scenes.tip: Practice drawing each idea by hand once.
